senses.gloss: निहित See s.v. p. 564.
नि॑-हित mfn. (√ 1. धा) laid, placed, deposited, fixed or kept in (loc.), RV. &c. &c.
delivered, given, bestowed, intrusted, ib.
laid down or aside, removed (see below), laid (as dust by rain), Ghaṭ.
encamped (as an army), Bhaṭṭ.
uttered in a deep tone, VPrāt. (cf. नि-हत).
निह् m. = नि-हन्तृ, AV.; VS. (Mahīdh.)
नि-˚हन् m. a killer, destroyer (ifc.), MBh.; R.
नि॑-˚हत (नि॑-), mfn. hurled, thrown, RV.
hit, touched (lit. and fig.), MBh.; Kāv.
struck down, smitten, slain, killed, destroyed, lost, gone, ib. &c.
having the unaccented tone or Anudātta (-त्व n.), TPrāt.
नि-˚हत—त्व n.
नि-˚हत—भूयिष्ठ mfn. having the greater number killed, R.
नि-˚हत—सेन mfn. having (their) armies smitten or destroyed, MW.
नि-˚ह˚तार्थ mfn. (word) whose meaning is out of use or obsolete (-ता f. -त्व n.), Sāh.
नि-˚ह˚तार्थ—ता f.
नि-˚ह˚तार्थ—त्व n.
नि-˚ह˚ताष्ट्र mfn. having the camels killed, whose camels have been slain, MW.
नि-˚हनन n. killing, slaughter, L.
नि-˚हन्तव्य mfn. to be struck down or killed or destroyed, MBh.; Pañc.
नि-˚हन्तृ m. a killer, destroyer, Mn.; MBh. &c.
one who removes or expels or hinders, Vikr.; Suśr.
N. of Śiva, MBh.
नि-हव See नि-ह्वे.
नि-˚हव m. invocation, calling, Br.; ŚrS.; ChUp.
(with वसिष्ठस्य or वसिष्ठ-) N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr. (cf. नि-ह्नव).

1. नि-√ 2. हा Ā. -जिहीते (3. pl. Impv. -जिहताम्), to descend, stoop, yield, RV.; ĀśvŚr. :
Desid. जिहीषते, to wish to stoop or yield, AV.

2. नि-√ हा only Pass. -हीयते, to be deficient or wanting or lost, RV.;
to be deprived of (instr.), Jātakam.
निहाका॑ f. ‘coming down’, a storm, whirlwind, RV.
an iguana, the Gangetic alligator, L. (according to Uṇ. iii, 42 fr. next).
नि-˚हीन mfn. low, vile, mean, MBh.; Kāv.
नि-हीन See नि-√ हा.
नि-˚हीन—तर mfn. lower, worse, Āpast.
नि-˚हीन—वर्ण mf(आ)n. of low caste or origin, MBh.
नि-हार &c. See नि-√ हृ.
नि-˚हार m. excrement, Viṣṇ. (cf. निर्-ह्˚)
mist, L. (cf. नी-ह्˚ under 5. नी).
नी—हार॑ m. (once n.) mist, fog, hoar-frost, heavy dew, RV. &c. &c. (cf. नि-हार under नि-हृ)
evacuation (cf. निर्-ह्˚)
नि-हिंसन n. (√ हिंस्) killing, slaughter, L.
नि-हित—दण्ड mfn. one who has laid aside the rod, who shows clemency, MW.
नि-हित—नयन mf(आ)n. having the eyes fixed or directed upon (loc.), Megh.
नि॑-हित—भाग (नि॑ह्˚), mfn. one whose share has been laid aside, MaitrS.
नि-√ हृ P. -हरति (ind.p. -हा॑रम्), to offer (as a gift or reward), VS.; AV.; TāṇḍyaBr.
नि-˚हारिन् w.r. for निर्-ह्˚.
नि-√ हृष् P. -हृष्यति. to sink down (as a flame), AitBr. (opp. to उद्-धृष्).
नि-˚ह्नव m. begging pardon, making amends or reparation (a kind of ceremony at which the Ṛtvij lay their hands upon the Prastara and recite, VS. v, 7), Sāy. on AitBr. i, 26 (also ˚ह्नवन, Gobh.)
atonement, expiation, amends for (gen.), Mn. ix, 21
denial, concealment, secrecy, mistrust, suspicion, Yājñ.; MBh.; Kāv.
contradiction, MBh.
eclipsing, obscuring, surpassing, Kāvyād.
wickedness, W.
N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.
नि-˚ह्नव—वादिन् m. a defendant or witness who prevaricates or tries to hide the truth, W.
नि-˚ह्न˚वोत्तर n. an evasive reply or defence, ib.
नि-˚ह्नुत mfn. denied, disowned, concealed, hidden, secreted, given out for something else, Ratnāv.; Kathās.; Rājat.
नि-˚ह्नुति f. denial, dissimulation, reserve, secrecy, concealment, Kāv.
नि-˚ह्नुवन n. id., Gobh.
v.l. for ˚ह्नवन, ib.
नि-˚ह्नुवान mfn. dissimulating, prevaricating, insinuating, W.
नि-√ ह्राद् Caus. -ह्रादयति, to cause to sound, beat (as a drum), MaitrS. (cf. निर्-ह्र्˚).
नि-˚ह्राद m. sound, noise, Ragh.; BhP. (cf. निर्-ह्र्˚)
नि-˚ह्राद—वत् mfn. sounding, pealing, Kir.
sounding, loud, Bcar.
नि-˚ह्रादित n. roaring, BhP.
नि-˚ह्रादिन् mfn. sounding, pealing, MW.
नि-√ ह्वे Ā. -ह्वयते (Pāṇ. i, 1, 30; 3. pl. -जुह्वते impf. -अह्वन्त ; Pass. -हूयते, RV.), to call down or near, invoke, RV.; AV.; AitBr.
नी—हार—कर m. ‘dew-maker’ or ‘cold-rayed’, the moon, Daś.
नी—हार—चक्षुस् mfn. one whose eyes are veiled by mist, BhP.
नी—हार—मय mf(ई)n. consisting of m˚, Kād.
नी—हा˚राय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become or make m˚, Pāṇ. iii, 1, 17, Vārtt. 2, Pat.
नी—हा˚री-√ कृ to convert into m˚, Mcar.
